posting_excerpt:

What we do:

The Trade Desk is a dynamic, fast-growing technology company and we require excellent leadership at all levels. We are looking for an experienced commercial transactions attorney who has excellent judgement, loves to analyze complex legal issues, find creative solutions, and effectively negotiate deals. We are looking for someone able to collaborate cross-functionally and primarily support our Data Partnerships teams to structure, draft, and negotiate deals while also balancing competing demands, working independently, maintaining a positive attitude and, hopefully, contributing some humor to our legal slack channel. The Trade Desk is a company that will invest in its employees’ professional development— as we grow, we want our employees to grow with us.

What you'll do:

- Exercise strong judgment to provide legal leadership on first impression global strategic data initiatives involving cutting edge areas such as retail data, measurement, and identity.

- Gain deep technical understanding of adtech data flows and technology to advise on innovative commercial deal frameworks.

- Structure, draft, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements with the largest data suppliers in the world, with a particular focus on data licensing and all aspects of data rights and usage.

- Collaborate with key leaders on our data partnerships, business development, product, privacy, and policy teams to advise on complex legal matters and develop creative solutions to contribute to the overall success of the company. 

- Continually improve our templates, playbooks, and legal processes to help us scale globally with a consistent but locally relevant approach and to help the company to move quickly and thoughtfully.

- Work closely with cross-functional teams to help streamline, automate, and scale The Trade Desk’s global data processes.

- Mentor other attorneys. 

- Provide practical advice on legal issues and risks, complex agreement structures, and company policies in a risk-tolerant, but compliance-oriented environment.

- Identify, research, analyze, and work with cross-functional teams to address potential risks related to a wide range of relevant legal topics (e.g., licensing, intellectual property, commercial, data security, and privacy laws).

- Keep abreast of legislative changes that may affect the company globally. 

- Distill and communicate complex legal concepts in layman’s terms.

Who you are: 

- 8+ years in house or in combination with an internationally/nationally recognized law firm experience required. 

- Admitted to practice in New York, Illinois, or California or the ability to register as In-House Counsel in New York, Illinois, or California. 

- Juris doctorate required. 

- Experience in digital advertising and/or digital media strongly preferred.

- Significant experience leading legal negotiations with large global companies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact with internal and external constituents at all levels and communicate complex legal concepts in layman’s terms.

- Experience managing outside counsel.

- Excellent business judgement, superior leadership skills, and strong commitment to providing timely and top-quality client service with superior work product. 

- Exceptional critical thinking skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, while juggling competing, time-sensitive demands. 

- Excellent legal skills, including significant experience in structuring, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a variety of commercial technology agreements. 

- Strong business sense and ability to exercise good business judgement.

- Excellent interpersonal skills (sense of humor is a big plus).

ney will act as a key Legal Product advisor, helping ensure that our products are innovative, responsible, and legally sound.

This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned legal professional with deep experience in technology, data protection, online safety, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate thrives in a high-growth, values-driven environment and is energized by the challenge of building trustworthy, compliant, and impactful member experiences.



What You'll Do

 - Act as the one of two primary legal advisors to product and engineering teams, providing guidance from initial design through launch and iteration.

 - Advise teams on key emerging areas for our core product, with a particular focus on generative AI,  online safety, content acquisition, IP/copyright, open source, and privacy issues.

 - Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Legal, Privacy, AI/ML, Compliance, and InfoSec to deliver clear, actionable legal advice that supports innovation while managing risk, increase speed and efficiency, and advance the long-term goals of Bumble.

 - Implement scalable legal processes, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, reduce cycle times, and help deliver high-quality guidance to product and engineering teams with greater speed and consistency.

 - Ensure products comply with data protection and privacy laws, including GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, online safety laws and related U.S. and international frameworks.

 - Serve as a legal project manager, coordinating legal input across teams (e.g., privacy, commercial, compliance) to deliver timely, integrated feedback to product teams.

 - Promote and implement privacy-by-design, safety by design, transparency, and member-first principles into new and existing products.

 - Partner closely with product, policy, trust & safety, and engineering teams to support responsible product development and carry out appropriate risk assessments.

 - Help with Trust and Safety escalation and transparency reports

 - Create playbooks, checklists, and scalable legal tools to support agile product development and reduce repetitive requests.

 - Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and communicate complex legal concepts with clarity and confidence.
   

About You

 - J.D. degree and active bar membership in good standing in the US

 - 5+ years of relevant legal experience, including in-house at a U.S.-based global tech company or top-tier law firm advising high-growth technology businesses.

 - Proven expertise advising product teams in areas such as privacy law, platform liability, and consumer protection.

 - Strong working knowledge of global privacy and data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, UK DPA).

 - Strong working knowledge of online safety laws, (e.g., age verification laws, Digital Services Act and Online Safety Act).

 - Demonstrated experience coordinating across multiple legal disciplines to ensure end-to-end coverage of regulatory and compliance risks.

 - A product mindset with an ability to embed legal solutions into design processes, UX, and system architecture.

 - Track record of influencing without authority, managing complex cross-functional projects, and supporting innovation at scale.

 - Strong process orientation and an eye for efficiency—you're always thinking about how to make things clearer, faster, and easier.

 - A commitment to Bumble’s mission and values, and a passion for building technologies that support healthy online experiences.

 - Must be based in Austin or New York
   

Why Join Bumble?

You’ll join a Legal team that’s small but mighty, collaborative, and deeply integrated into how Bumble builds its products. We’re looking for someone who sees legal not as a roadblock but as a strategic enabler of innovation and trust. This is your opportunity to shape how legal thinking informs next-generation technology in a company that puts its members first.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly-collaborative Senior Legal Counsel to support our North American region and provide practical and business-focused guidance to internal and external stakeholders.

This role will focus on high-volume commercial contract negotiation and providing strategic and operational legal counsel across all areas of our business. This role will work closely with account and growth leaders, commercial finance, content and technology teams, and data/privacy experts to ensure efficient contract execution, manage legal risks, and enable business growth across our North American operations.

- Draft, review, and negotiate a high-volume of commercial contracts in North America, including client MSAs and SOWs, technology licensing and reseller agreements, influencer and media partnerships, SaaS/vendor agreements, and production-related agreements. 

- Work closely with commercial finance and business teams to respond to RFPs and RFIs from our clients and participate actively in client pitches to help our business win.

Your Impact 

As Axon’s Corporate Counsel, you will serve as a key member of Axon’s contracts and corporate team supporting the sales teams around the world. You will partner with members of external teams such as Sales, Supply Chain, Software and Hardware Engineering, Product and IT to structure and negotiate complex transactions, as well as build processes to help build for a rapidly scaling business.

What You’ll Do 

Reports to: Deputy General Counsel

Location: Any US Axon hub office location, required to be in-office 4x week (Tuesday - Friday) 

- Provide legal advice to global business partners (primarily including a growing and dynamic Sales organization) on transactional matters related to sale of Axon’s market-leading portfolio of public safety technology products, including, for example:

- structuring, reviewing and negotiating contracts for the disposition of Axon’s goods, services and SaaS solutions; and

- providing and recommending options for business partners with respect to contract negotiations and corresponding risk analyses.

- Supervise and review the Contracts Managers’ work.

- Set and enforce the risk levels acceptable to Axon through approvals and ownership of the knowledge bank and playbooks.

- Lead, support, execute and evolve team processes to help us build Legal contracting support for scale, including, for example:

- drafting, updating and maintaining template contract language, risk analyses, and policies and procedures; and

- supporting the development and implementation of our contract lifecycle management system.

- Provide other legal advice as needed related to Axon’s operations, including, for example, regulatory compliance matters or other legal requirements, and industry standards.

- Collaborate with other attorneys, contracts managers and administrative support to help grow, mentor and learn from others.

What You Bring

- Minimum of 3 years of experience (in-house preferred) negotiating and managing complex commercial contracts.

- Ability to structure, draft, and negotiate a high volume of commercial contracts, including those for the sale of SaaS, hardware, and services.

- Experience negotiating SaaS, IaaS and/or PaaS contracts.

- Ability to act with urgency on all requests.

- Pass-first attitude with a desire to learn new topics and take on new challenges.

- Experience negotiating international agreements.

- Passion for process and organization.

- J.D. and member in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

- Experience with using AI including using it to automate processes building applications to simplify workflows.

- Ability to manage a large workload and pivot quickly between tasks as the business needs change.

Nice To Have

- Deep understanding of other software tools surrounding the contract process, preferably Generative AI, SalesForce, CLMs, and Microsoft Office.

- Experience negotiating with US, State, Local governments and Federal.

- Knowledge of government procurement laws

- Experience negotiating contracts with international government customers preferably Canada and LATAM.

- Previous experience as a sales representative.

- Experience negotiating telecommunication contracts with large telecommunication providers and end users.

Benefits that Benefit You

- Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

- Discretionary paid time off

- Paid parental leave for all

- Medical, Dental, Vision plans

- Fitness Programs

- Emotional & Mental Wellness support

- Learning & Development programs

- Stock equity programs

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

WHAT YOU BRING

You come from the world of funds, asset management, or M&A; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have practiced as a private funds associate at a leading law firm, negotiating fund documents, side letters, and co-investment structures. Perhaps you've worked in-house at an asset manager, running lean legal processes across the full fund lifecycle. Maybe you've built your career in compliance, managing regulatory obligations, exams, and investor requirements at an investment firm. Or you may have cut your teeth in M&A or ECVC, running diligence and negotiating transaction documents under deal pressure.
